WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        district_id,
        COUNT(*) as client_count
    FROM client
    GROUP BY district_id
),
total AS (
    SELECT SUM(client_count) as total_count
    FROM district_counts
    WHERE district_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    dc.district_id,
    dc.client_count,
    dc.client_count * 1.0 / t.total_count as ratio
FROM district_counts dc
CROSS JOIN total t
WHERE dc.district_id IS NOT NULL
    AND t.total_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
